item.title: French Polynesia Cabin Cruise: The Floating Boutique Hotel for Effortless Island Hopping
item.description: Imagine waking up in a comfortable suite aboard a premium catamaran. You stretch out on crisp sheets and wonder what spectacular view is awaiting you today. Will it be the majestic twin peaks of Bora Bora or the white sand beaches and tropical jungles of Huahine? You step on deck and sniff the air: today’s port is actually the vanilla-scented shores of Taha’a. That’s what life is like aboard a French Polynesia cabin cruise. Every day, you get to go on a new adventure. At night, you rest and relax in the comfort of a spacious cabin aboard a shared catamaran charter. For many travelers, the freedom to visit multiple destinations rather than be confined to a single resort makes a cabin cruise a much better option than a typical holiday on land. What Is a French Polynesia Cabin Cruise? A French Polynesia catamaran cruise or cabin cruise is a travel option where you book a private cabin with its own attached bathroom on a catamaran. Instead of chartering an entire yacht yourself, you share the vessel with a small group of other travelers. How Cabin Cruises Work The catamaran operates much like a small-scale cruise ship but with a personalized touch. Your captain navigates the islands, and an onboard steward prepares your meals. This vacation style eliminates the stress of trip planning, sailing logistics, and meal preparation. And since vessels are shared among travelers, cabin cruises are more affordable than booking Tahiti yacht charters . Why It Feels Like a Floating Boutique Hotel Unlike massive cruise ships that carry thousands of passengers, a catamaran hosts between 8 and 12 guests. This creates an intimate atmosphere, similar to that of a small hotel, except you also get to experience different destinations and activities every day. In French Polynesia, our cabin cruises are offered on the Bali 5.4, Lagoon 620, and the Fountaine Pajot Ipanema 58, each accommodating 12 guests. Comfort and Convenience: What Is a Cabin Cruise Like Onboard? Life aboard a cabin charter is defined by relaxation and comfort. Your catamaran features decks, shaded outdoor dining areas, and a forward trampoline net. This net is a great spot to lounge as the islands glide by. No jostling for sunbathing space on crowded beaches or lining up to rent gear from stands along the shore. You can get all the sun you want on deck, and the cruise includes the use of water sports equipment. You can step directly off the yacht’s transom steps into the water, swim, snorkel, or kayak to your heart’s content. Island Hopping Without Repacking or Airport Transfers With 118 islands and atolls spread across an area as vast as Western Europe, French Polynesia island hopping is all about discovering the unique character of each destination. However, having your base camp be a hotel or resort limits your options. It also means you have to go through a drawn-out process of getting there before you can visit each different island. Traditional travelers must pack their suitcases, check out of their resorts, take a taxi to the airport, wait in security lines, and fly to the next island, only to repeat the check-in process. Meanwhile, on Tahiti cabin cruises , you unpack your bags once on arrival. While you relax on deck or sleep in your cabin, the catamaran moves you between Tahiti and other destinations like Huahine, Raiatea, Taha’a, and Bora Bora. A Tahiti cabin charter eliminates the need for regional flights and ferry schedules, saving you both travel stress and vacation time. Space, Food, Privacy, and Seasickness: Honest Answers Before booking a sailing trip, it is normal to have a few questions about how things work on a boat. Here is what daily life aboard your shared luxury catamaran looks like. Space: Yacht cabins are smaller than hotel rooms, but they’re just as well-appointed. They feature built-in storage and ensuite bathrooms, with air-conditioning at specified daylight hours when you want a break from the tropical heat. Food: Your steward handles all the grocery …

item.title: Why The Bali 5.4 Should be Your Next Charter
item.description: The Bali 5.4 brings together space, comfort, and performance all in an impeccably designed 54-foot catamaran perfect for charter vacations. This yacht was built with a focus on open bright living spaces, comfortable accommodations, and plentiful outdoor spaces. With room for up to 12 in its six-cabin configuration, the Bali 5.4 is perfect for social sailing. Dream Yacht guests have the option to enjoy this yacht through a cabin cruise or when the yacht has availability outside of cabin charters, book it as a crewed yacht charter for an exclusive experience with family and friends. A Layout Designed for Living The center of the Bali 5.4’s design was built around bringing people together while still allowing space to spread out. Fluid flowing spaces from bow to stern creates seamless connection between the outdoor living areas, saloon, and aft cockpit. One of the most distinctive and innovative features of this yacht is the large pivoting rear door. It excellently connects the salon with the aft cockpit creating one extended living area and allowing for a larger conversation space. Another unique feature is the sliding windows that allow for more airflow and light giving an open air feel throughout. Forward of the saloon a door provides easy access to the foredeck. Here cushioned seats stretch out into the sun allowing guests to relax and enjoy the views while underway. While the aft cockpit provides a perfect gathering space for lunch or dinner at anchor with comfortable seating. The davits and swim ladder on the stern provide an easy access to the water for swimming. Then above there is a flybridge with a large U shaped seating area perfect for sipping a morning coffee with the sunrise or sundowners after a rewarding day of cruising. Forward of the seating area find the sunbathing pads where guests can lounge while taking in the breathtaking scenery of one of Dream Yacht’s incredible destinations. This Bali 5.4 provides so many areas where connection to the natural world and each other become possible. Find peace and shared experiences through innovation and exploration aboard this yacht. Take the Tour Comfortable Accommodations Below Deck The Bali 5.4 continues to deliver through its focus on comfort as we move below deck. Each cabin is equipped with queen sized beds, a private bathroom with a shower, and adequate storage space. Natural light and airflow are still features even down in the cabins; some cabins even have direct access to the deck. For large groups this layout is meant to give everyone their own private space at night, while relishing the communal spaces during the day. Guests get the feeling of home and settling in through these comfortable areas instead of the fleeting feeling of a hotel room. Why Charter the Bali 5.4 Space for Everyone – Roughly 130 square meters of living space allows for plenty of room to dine, relax, and enjoy cruising without feeling crowded. Indoor/Outdoor Living – The yacht’s flow from bow to stern and one of a kind opening door from the saloon to the aft cabin makes it easy to roam between the interior and exterior living spaces. Enjoy the breeze blowing through the yacht which creates a light airy open feel that connects you to the natural beauty of the surrounding world. Relaxation Area Options – There is no shortage of lounging areas onboard from the flybridge to the foredeck choose your ideal spot to enjoy the sail from. Now Newly Available for Private Crewed Charters When a Bali 5.4 is not being used on a cabin charter it will be available for a private crewed charter experience with a captain and hostess. This means families or groups of friends can experience the entire yacht privately, with a professional crew taking care of the sailing, itinerary, food, and day to day operation. Allowing guests to concentrate on relaxation and taking in the scenery from any of the comfortable lounging areas. item.title: Chartering A Power Catamaran With Dream Yacht Charter
item.description: Back in May we announced the exciting addition of power catamarans to our fleet, starting with initial availability in the British Virgin Islands , La Paz , and the Bahamas . But what do these FP Maestro 37ft yachts offer in terms of pros? We’ve put together the key benefits of how power catamarans offer a whole new experience for our charterers. Top power catamaran benefits Speed: It goes without saying that motor yachts tend to be a lot faster than sail yachts. Motor yachts like the FP Maestro 37 can hit up to 22 knots or so, depending on the sea conditions, which gives a great sense of freedom for thrill seekers. Sail yachts hit around 9-10 knots and are completely reliant on sea and wind conditions, plus the skills of the crew Efficiency: The extra 10 knots you have on a motor yacht means you can make the most of your vacation time. You can cover distances in half the time it takes a sail yacht, making motor yachts the perfect choice for island hopping and going short distances. This is why we featured motor yachts at our most popular island hopping and line of sight sailing destinations, so you can have more time exploring favourite islands or discovering new locations Clearance: Motor yachts also have low clearance, which means they are ideal for going under low bridges Relaxation: Their lack of a mast also makes motor yachts a perfect grab n’ go charter boat, as you won’t have to worry about raising or lowering sails. This means you won’t have to call your guests to be all hands on deck, but can focus on relaxing and letting the motor do the work Accessible: You can charter motor catamarans with just power boat experience on your bareboat resume. This means they are a great way for someone who may want to charter in international waters but have yet to gain sailing experience. If you don’t have any sailing or power boat experience, we can also book a professional captain to handle the vessel for you Our team is here to answer any questions to share current charter pricing and availability of our new lineup of FP Maestro 37s, just call our office at 855-650-8902 or email us . item.title: New BALI Catamarans arriving in the Seychelles
item.description: As Dream Yacht’s first base location and founding sailing destination nearly 25 years ago, the Seychelles Islands hold a place of honor in the hearts and minds of our Dream Yacht Worldwide charter team. Now we’re pleased to announce the arrival of two brand new catamarans soon to be available for charter in this very special island paradise. The new yachts, BALI 4.4 and BALI 4.6 catamarans, are now in transit arriving in December and available for charters from December 14, 2024. BALI yachts are one of our most sought-after charter brands, making these new 2024 “Super Premier” catamarans an exciting addition to our Seychelles fleet. About the new BALI Catamarans The BALI 4.4 is a 44-foot 4-cabin/4-bath catamaran, perfect for families or groups of friends up to 10 people. The 5-cabin/4-bath BALI 4.6 is 46-feet, and is well-suited for larger groups or for allowing space for a hired skipper. Both yachts feature the popular “garage-door” style pivoting door that creates an open air salon that lends itself to comfortable indoor/outdoor living. Both yachts also feature spacious flybridge lounge areas for comfortable seating with a view while underway, or for sunset gatherings. Sailing the Seychelles Islands We began our first Dream Yacht charters in the Seychelles for good reason. This Indian Ocean Island chain is arguably one of the most beautiful sailing grounds on the planet, with 41 of the earth’s oldest granite islands and 74 low-lying islands surrounded by brilliant blue waters and pristine reefs. For nature lovers, the bird watching, hiking, and snorkeling are unmatched. And a visit to the protected island of Curieuse to observe the gentle giant Aldabra tortoises and unique coco de mer palms is a must. Underscoring Dream Yacht’s strong commitment to delivering top sailing opportunities in the beautiful Seychelles, we will welcome additional BALI yachts – 2 BALI 4.8 catamarans – in the Seychelles late in 2025. Plan now for your dream Seychelles sailing vacation to secure one of these stunning new sailing catamarans. Get in touch with a Dream Yacht charter planner today! Share: Link Copied to Clipboard
